description: This file defines the BufferParser class and its derived classes AudioBufferParser and VideoBufferParser, which are responsible for parsing media buffer data in a GStreamer-based media pipeline. It includes method declarations for parsing buffers and adding metadata, as well as handling different encryption formats.

classes.name: BufferParser
classes.description: Abstract base class for parsing media buffers, providing an interface for parsing buffer data and adding metadata, with a focus on handling encryption formats.

classes.name: AudioBufferParser
classes.description: Derived class implementing buffer parsing specific to audio streams.

classes.name: VideoBufferParser
classes.description: Derived class implementing buffer parsing specific to video streams.

methods.name: parseBuffer
methods.description: Parses a media buffer sample and returns a MediaSegment object.

methods.name: parseSpecificPartOfBuffer
methods.description: Pure virtual method to parse specific parts of the buffer, implemented differently for audio and video.

methods.name: addProtectionMetadataToSegment
methods.description: Adds encryption protection metadata to a media segment.

methods.name: addCodecDataToSegment
methods.description: Adds codec-specific data to a media segment.
